construct: MYH7 encodes beta-cardiac myosin heavy chain, a thick-filament motor protein of the sarcomere. Pathogenic variants in MYH7 are a major autosomal-dominant cause of nonsyndromic hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Unexplained asymmetric LV hypertrophy, familial sudden death, and a pathogenic MYH7 variant identify sarcomeric HCM; MYH7 encodes beta-cardiac myosin heavy chain, a core myosin component of the sarcomere thick filament.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Thin-filament/Z-disc, L-type calcium-channel, desmosomal, and RYR2 proteins are distinct structures. The direct MYH7-to-beta-myosin link plus explicit thick-filament source makes the correct structural location unique.
